title: Mobile Wallet Bounced-Credit Resend: Payments Desk Tool Card
content:
**Mobile Wallet** — sending a bounced credit again to the same wallet.

## Situation and business effect
When a Mobile Wallet credit has bounced and the transfer stands with a failed credit (status credit failed), the customer may instruct Paloma to send it again to the wallet the transfer is addressed to. The resend goes out as a new credit attempt, and the transfer moves from credit failed back to processing.

The tool `resend_failed_credit_8d2e2e1a` sends that resend. Its effect, as the tool itself defines it:

- the whole principal Paloma currently holds for the transfer is sent to its wallet provider as a new credit attempt, at the exchange rate and local amount given;
- one credit-sent entry is booked, dated today, and the principal Paloma holds for the transfer drops to 0.00;
- the transfer moves to processing, with its release moment set to now and its date available set to today;
- the wallet destination stays as it is, and the customer and recipient can follow the credit as in progress.

## Prerequisite clause
For a resend beyond the tier's free resends, the amount it credits is fixed only after the charge assessed for that resend stands on the transfer's ledger.

Put the other way round: where the resend's number is above the tier's free resends, the amount to be credited is not settled while no charge for that resend is recorded on the transfer's ledger.

## How it is invoked
`resend_failed_credit_8d2e2e1a` is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `wallet_transfer_id` | the reference number of the Mobile Wallet transfer whose bounced credit is sent again, as returned by the Mobile Wallet transfer lookup | identifier |
| `credit_attempt` | the number of this credit attempt on the transfer, one more than the credits already sent on the transfer | integer count starting at 1 |
| `fx_rate_applied` | the exchange rate this credit converts at | payout-currency units per 1 USD, 4 decimal places, already rounded half up |
| `receive_amount` | the amount this credit delivers to the wallet | payout currency, 2 decimal places, already rounded half up |

The values are booked as given; the tool does not work them out.

## Return
A dictionary rendered as text with `ledger_entry_id` (reference of the new credit-sent entry), `wallet_transfer_id`, `credit_attempt` (integer attempt number), `amount_usd` (USD principal sent, 2 decimals), `fx_rate_applied` (4 decimals), `receive_amount` (payout currency, 2 decimals), `status` (now processing) and `released_at` (moment sent, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS). A receipt with a `ledger_entry_id` and status processing means the credit went out.
